title: Okay value
text: Okay value. I’ve been running this AC unit for about a month now on and off. It works pretty well but it takes a while to cool my room down completely. Now it’s starting to make a buzzing sound like something is stuck or getting caught from time to time. Plus the hose on the back completely came off from the piece that connects it to the machine. I’m glad I was able to get this ac for the record breaking summer, but I’m not sure it’s worth it.
